llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create a dedicated runtime with `createWorkletRuntime(...)` and schedule compute onto it with `scheduleOnRuntime(runtime, worklet, ...)`, not deprecated `runOnRuntime`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No createWorkletRuntime or scheduleOnRuntime calls exist anywhere. The code uses runOnUI from react-native-reanimated instead.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge runtime results back to React with `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scheduleOnRN is never called. react-native-worklets is not imported. The code mutates shared values directly (progress.value, status.value) inside a worklet instead of bridging via scheduleOnRN.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN` calls behind an explicit cadence condition (for example modulo/batch checkpoints plus final batch) instead of calling `scheduleOnRN` on every compute iteration.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Although an i % BRIDGE_EVERY_N_BATCHES === 0 cadence gate exists structurally, it gates direct shared value mutations rather than scheduleOnRN calls, which is the required API. The requirement cannot be satisfied without scheduleOnRN being present.
